summary: Lower || with JavaScript truthiness, short-circuiting, and operand-value return semantics.

target.notes: Evaluate left once. If ToBoolean(left) is true, return left unchanged; otherwise evaluate and return right.

caveats: C# || is only equivalent when both operands and result are proven Boolean.

tests.name: edge truthy empty array skips right
tests.input: let x=0; const v=[] || ++x; console.log(Array.isArray(v), x);
